ValidationRule.description: New advisor response evidence cannot be in the future or precede Case creation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISCHANGED(First_Response_On__c), NOT(ISBLANK(First_Response_On__c)), OR(First_Response_On__c > NOW(), AND(NOT(ISNEW()), First_Response_On__c < CreatedDate)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: First response must be between Case creation and the current time.
